name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next
description: Highest-priority Fast candidate for long agent sessions.
limitations: The official BF16 checkpoint measured 2.15 decode tok/s and 24.3 s warm TTFT on the first complete-checkpoint probe, so the promotion candidate uses conversion-time NVFP4 routed experts.
The full NVFP4 checkpoint measured 12.58 decode tok/s and 0.833 s warm TTFT with route-first sparse prefill; this is Frontier-class performance, not Fast-class throughput.
The NVFP4 recipe must pass complete-checkpoint output, parser, agent, context, memory, and endurance gates before promotion.
QSA selection currently runs eagerly, so CUDA graph capture is disabled.
The published checkpoint is multimodal; initial Spark Lab certification is text-only.
Final tier is determined by measured recipe performance.
